entries.name: The Unrecorded Tally in the Drain
entries.description: Uc worries that rats in the Back Courts Undercroft will gnaw clean through an old debt-sheet before dawn.
entries.lead_text: Uc taps a damp boot: something crowned in fur is nesting beneath the Back Courts drains.

entries.name: Loose Leaf Below the Stair
entries.description: Clerk Anselm slipped a Day-House tally sheet loose of its binding; reaching the Archive Stair keeps it uncatalogued.
entries.lead_text: Clerk Anselm folds an unnumbered sheet behind his cuff—carry the count past the Archive Stair.

entries.name: Tanner's Cold Mark
entries.description: Tibors offers to score an unfiled pass-tag on your palm—either spill a little blood now or refuse his knife.
entries.lead_text: Tibors uncorks gall-ink by the lime-vats: pay blood for an unfiled pass, or turn away cleanly.

entries.name: Short Brass at the Flues
entries.description: Peyre suspects the Sun-House Furnaces hold salvaged alloy untouched by Prosay's assay stamp.
entries.lead_text: Peyre points down the smoke-shaft: reach the Sun-House Furnaces before the smelter crew shifts.

entries.name: Carrying the Margin Word
entries.description: Mirande wants word carried down to Orable so the Readers' Circles know a page survived the audit.
entries.lead_text: Mirande asks you to seek Orable along the lower stairs and pass the margin-mark aloud.

entries.name: Testing the Lent Glass
entries.description: Orable asks you to work a Relic by quiet flame rather than surrender it to Dominion custody.
entries.lead_text: Orable murmurs that a worked Relic answers differently down in unrecorded stone.

entries.name: The Grate Marshal's Reckoning
entries.description: Beneath the Processional Underway, Marshal Krell drills troops on short stamps; Hesper wants the post broken.
entries.lead_text: You hear iron grates ringing below—Marshal Krell keeps the Processional Underway shut.

entries.name: Clean Oil for the Shut Chapel
entries.description: Brother Calix seeks refuge in the Shut Chapel Crypt after leaving the Sun-House flues behind.
entries.lead_text: Brother Calix smells clean beeswax on the draft: step once into the Shut Chapel Crypt.

entries.name: Witness at the Seventh Sill
entries.description: Wren believes the Preliator Sentinel must fall before anyone speaks cleanly on the surface.
entries.lead_text: Wren taps the chalk jamb: break the Preliator Sentinel beneath the seventh Sphere.

entries.name: Broth for the Unfiled
entries.description: Almoner Dessa rations thin broth by hand—give a measure of vigor now or guard your own reserves.
entries.lead_text: Almoner Dessa lifts a scorched ladle: share blood or rations to stretch the cellar pot.

entries.name: Snapping the Wax Stamp
entries.description: Ferrant urges transmuting a Relic cleanly instead of keeping its sealed weight intact.
entries.lead_text: Ferrant eyes your satchel: transmute a Relic cleanly to break the old stamp's tether.

entries.name: Frost on the Tithe Axle
entries.description: Odo dropped an unrecorded axle-pin somewhere along the Tithe Road Tunnels.
entries.lead_text: Odo whistles from the curb: inspect the Tithe Road Tunnels for his stalled cart.

entries.name: Silencing the Brass Key
entries.description: Sister Vesper asks that the Choir Cantor Prime be silenced before false music fills the Cloister.
entries.lead_text: Faint brass chords echo from the Gilded Choir; Sister Vesper covers her ears.

entries.name: Counter-Signed Obligation
entries.description: Whenever you bear a divine contract, Tallyman Corvin watches whether you attest it before stone rather than flee.
entries.lead_text: Tallyman Corvin slides an unsigned nib forward: attest your active contract at a Ritual Circle.

entries.name: Ink-Stained Cistern Sluice
entries.description: Runoff beneath the Iron Scriptorium carries torn seal-parchment down into the Audit Cisterns.
entries.lead_text: Keeper Sable watches black water seep under the Scriptorium door toward the Audit Cisterns.

entries.name: After the Furnace Falls
entries.description: Smelter Prosay's collapse leaves Cantor Helios Prime exposed in the False Solar Court.
entries.lead_text: Precentor Jule steps out of the smoke: turn your blade on Cantor Helios Prime.

entries.name: Leaden Weights Below
entries.description: Brother Bram suspects debtors' tokens from the Unrecorded Market are heaped in the Debts Cathedral.
entries.lead_text: Brother Bram weighs a leaden coin: walk the Debts Cathedral to trace where the tally runs.

entries.name: The Seventh Keyholder
entries.description: Old Warden Tomas warns that the Jailer of the Seventh still locks chains over the bottom stairwell.
entries.lead_text: Warden Tomas listens through the Garrison grate: break the Jailer of the Seventh.

entries.name: Chained Folio in the Stacks
entries.description: Inside the Closed Stacks Vault, Binder Malakor keeps unindexed codices nailed shut.
entries.lead_text: Mirande whispers from behind a shelf: slay Binder Malakor to free the chained leaves.

entries.name: Through Confessor's Glass
entries.description: Holding the Confessor's Glass makes confiscated reliquaries in the Velvet Ossuary stand out sharply.
entries.lead_text: The Confessor's Glass hums softly toward the Velvet Ossuary.

entries.name: Quenching the Great Die
entries.description: At the Seal Foundry Deep, Forge-Warden Cyrus stamps fresh iron collars for the Decrees above.
entries.lead_text: Hot iron rings down in the Seal Foundry Deep—shatter Forge-Warden Cyrus's stamp.

entries.name: Where Bronze Keys Turn
entries.description: The Ophite Key resonates beside green salt fractures deep beneath Jupiter.
entries.lead_text: Your Ophite Key tugs quietly toward the Ophite Seam Hollow.

entries.name: Beyond the Ruled Column
entries.description: From the Chamber of Decrees, runners speak of raw unruled stone off the seventh stair.
entries.lead_text: Odo marks a torn corner on your sleeve: step once into the Unwritten Margin.

entries.name: Clean Flagstones at Saturn
entries.description: Beside the Sealed Stair lies a quiet hermitage where no chair or ledger stands.
entries.lead_text: Wren points beyond the final ward: seek peace for one breath inside the Witness Hermitage.
